study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Fraza et al., Nature Mental Health, 2024
study_identification_part.si4_title: Unraveling the link between CNVs, cognition and individual neuroimaging deviation scores from a population-based reference cohort

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study clearly states its primary objective and hypotheses. It aims to understand the individualized impacts of pathogenic CNVs on brain structure and behavior using normative modeling.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: In this study, our primary objective is to dive into the individualized impacts of pathogenic CNVs on brain structure and behavior... We hypothesize that (1) individuals with a CNV related to cognitive deficits or neurodevelopmental disorders will have larger deviation scores... and (2) that the patterns of deviation across brain regions will be highly variable...

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: The study describes using data from five publicly available repositories (Cam-CAN, HCP, OASIS, PNC, UK Biobank) and mentions visual quality control procedures resulting in a final sample size of 19,620.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: To create the voxel-wise Jacobian normative model... we pooled a large dataset from five publicly available repositories: Cam-CAN [53], HCP [54], Oasis [55], PNC [56] and UK Biobank [37]... Visual inspection was performed to ensure data quality [7], resulting in a total of 19,620 participants with MRI scans passing the quality control assessment.

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: The study explicitly states that age and sex were used as covariates, and site effects were handled as a fixed effect in the model.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: Every normative model constructed factored in the covariates age and sex. To reduce site effects, we have added it as a fixed effect in the model.

nm5_data_preprocessing.reason: The study describes the preprocessing software (FSL) and steps (normalization, non-linear registration to MNI152 space) for the Jacobian model. It also references FUNPACK for the IDP analysis.
nm5_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: The data were preprocessed with a registration to a standard spatial reference using FSL's FLIRT and FNIRT... Jacobian determinant images derived from the non-linear image registration to the MNI152 space indicate the degree of local volume expansion or contraction

nm8_normative_modeling_approach.reason: The study specifies the use of Bayesian linear regression with likelihood warping (Sinarcsinh), a B-spline basis function, and the PCNtoolkit software.
nm8_normative_modeling_approach.supporting_text: We employed the Bayesian linear regression function from the PCNtoolkit... To ensure accurate modeling of nonlinear and non-Gaussian effects, we employed a B-spline basis function and likelihood warping

nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.supporting_text: The resulting models explained as much as 52% of the variation... To validate the models we used several model fit criteria. Among these were the kurtosis and skewness... Fig. 3 | Overview of normative modeling results.

nm11_reproducibility.supporting_text: Python version 3.8 and PCNtoolkit version 0.28 were used... The models used for all analyses are accessible at GitHub via https://github.com/amarquand/PCNtoolkit and https://github. com/CharFraza/CNV_normative_modeling/.

cr1_selection_criteria_clinical_cohort.reason: The study describes the identification of CNVs based on a previous dataset (Crawford et al.) and lists the quality control criteria used (genotypic call rate, waviness factor, etc.).
cr1_selection_criteria_clinical_cohort.supporting_text: We identified CNVs based on the returned dataset from Crawford et al... Briefly, their quality control included genotypic call rate <0.96, waviness factor of <-0.03 and >0.03, >30 CNVs per person, and log R ratio s.d. of >0.35.

cr2_handling_of_clinical_covariates.reason: The study analyses correlations between deviation scores and cognition but does not appear to control for clinical covariates such as medication status or comorbidities in these specific analyses.
cr2_handling_of_clinical_covariates.supporting_text: We examined the Spearman correlation between the total count of extreme positive deviation scores... and the general cognitive ability score... Using the covariates age, sex and site [in the normative model construction].

cr5_clinical_assessment_measures.reason: The study describes the derivation of a general cognitive ability score from seven specific cognitive tests in the UK Biobank.
cr5_clinical_assessment_measures.supporting_text: we generated a general cognitive ability score for each participant by calculating the first principal component from the various cognitive tests within the UK Biobank dataset (see Supplementary Fig. 7 for an overview of the tests used).

cr6_interpretation_of_deviation_scores.supporting_text: negative deviations refer to instances where certain brain regions show more volume contractions...
